note: Each `line` is one NDJSON line including its trailing newline. `rights` is how many SCM_RIGHTS descriptors arrived with it. Keys are in schema order; the line must re-serialize byte for byte. Text version 2 (every L1 line has `"v":2`): `begin` ends with `receiptKey` (the installation's receipt MAC key, canonical padded base64 of exactly 32 bytes; the key in these vectors is the SYNTHETIC `synthetic-receipt-key-0123456789`), and a Class A receipt inside `stopped` ends with `mac`.
